Participants: Hispanic man and woman, 55 years old and older with diagnosed T2DM
Interventions, group ( n ): Control (31) : recommended to continue usual standard of care. Resistance (31) : 60–80% of 1RM during the first 9 weeks and 70–80% of 1RM on weeks 10–16.
Results: Reduction in serum CRP level in resistance training group compared with control group. Increase in adiponectin concentrations in resistance group compared with control group.
Remarks: Data from CRP and adiponectin were exposed as median and interquartile range.

Participants: Man and woman aged 30–70 years diagnosed with T2DM and with body mass index between 25 and 40 kg/m 2
Interventions, group ( n ): Control (12) : light stretching exercise. Aerobic (12) : up to lactate threshold. Resistance (12) : load not described. Combination (12) : aerobic and resistance training with the same intensity of the other training groups and half of the exercise volume on each category.
Inflammatory status variables analyzed: hsCRP (mg/ml) Adiponectin ( μ g/ml) Visfatin (ng/ml) Resistin (ng/ml) TNF- α (pg/ml) Interleukin -6 (pg/ml)
Results: Reduction in hsCRP serum level in all groups, including control after intervention. Increase in visfatin serum level in all groups, including control after intervention. Nonsignificant changes in adiponectin, resistin, TNF- α , or interleukin-6 in either group after intervention.
Remarks: Data before and after intervention exposed on analytical values (mean ± standard deviation).

Participants: Man and woman aged 50–70 years with a diagnosis of T2DM
Interventions, group ( n ): Control (27) : 150 minutes/week of self-managed physical activity. Aerobic (26) : progressive load until 60%–75% of HR max .
Results: Increment on apelin serum level after the intervention period on aerobic training group compared with control group. Nonsignificant effect on ghrelin serum level in the intervention group.
Remarks: Data from apelin and ghrelin were exposed on graphs without values of mean and standard deviation.

Participants: Man and woman with T2DM diagnosed for more than 1 year
Interventions, group ( n ): Control (24) : 150 minutes/week of self-managed physical activity. Resistance (23) : 2-3 sets of 6–8 repetitions on machine weights. Exercise intensity of 60–80% of 1RM.
Results: Nonsignificant changes in CRP levels between the groups after the intervention.
Remarks: Data expressed as delta variation (mean ± standard deviation).

Participants: Man and woman ≥60 years of age, sedentary with type 2 diabetes and metabolic syndrome
Interventions, group ( n ): Control (47) : training on the same equipment used by resistance group, 3 times a week, under supervision from the same trainers. Exercise intensity as low as possible and not progressing. Resistance (41) : 3 sets of 8 repetitions. Exercise intensity of 80% of 1RM.
Intervention period: Session duration not informed, 3x/week, for 12 months
Results: Reduction in CRP in resistance group relative to control group.
